definition: A commitment to locate, relocate, route or position infrastructure and facilities on the basis of climate and disaster risk: avoiding flood zones, unstable slopes, erosion-prone coastlines, wildfire-prone areas and other hazard-exposed locations, or choosing underground over overhead routing for that reason. Counts when climate or hazard information directly shapes a siting or routing decision the project finances or requires. The assessment that produces the hazard information is a separate measure (climate risk assessment); this one is the decision. Does not count: ordinary network expansion, land acquisition, resettlement, routing to avoid ecologically sensitive areas, or site selection not linked to climate or disaster risk.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
